use default
use Raster.IMAGE

let width = 10
let height = 10
let trials = 100

let random = System.Random(21)

class GRID is
    floors: bool[]
    sides: bool[]
    wet: LIST[bool]

    init(p: double) is
        floors =
            (0..(height + 1) * width)
                |> map(_ => random.next_double() < p)
                |> collect_array()

        sides =
            (0..height * (width + 1))
                |> map(i =>
                    let column = i % (width + 1) in
                    column == 0 \/ column == width \/
                        random.next_double() < p)
                |> collect_array()

        wet = repeat(false, width * height) |> collect_list()
    si

    floor(column: int, row: int) -> bool => floors[row * width + column]

    side(column: int, row: int) -> bool =>
        sides[row * (width + 1) + column]

    is_wet(column: int, row: int) -> bool => wet[row * width + column]

    pour() -> bool is
        let pending = STACK[(int, int)]()

        for column in 0..width do
            if !floor(column, 0) then
                pending.push((column, 0))
            fi
        od

        while pending.count > 0 do
            let (column, row) = pending.pop()

            if !is_wet(column, row) then
                wet[row * width + column] = true

                if row + 1 < height /\ !floor(column, row + 1) then
                    pending.push((column, row + 1))
                fi

                if row > 0 /\ !floor(column, row) then
                    pending.push((column, row - 1))
                fi

                if !side(column, row) then
                    pending.push((column - 1, row))
                fi

                if !side(column + 1, row) then
                    pending.push((column + 1, row))
                fi
            fi
        od

        return drips() |> any(_ => true)
    si

    drips() -> Pipe[int] =>
        (0..width) |> filter(column =>
            is_wet(column, height - 1) /\ !floor(column, height))
si

write_line("p      fraction of {trials} {width} by {height} grids dripping")

let shown: GRID? mut = null

for step in 0::10 do
    let p = cast double(step) / 10.0D
    let grids = (0..trials) |> map(_ => GRID(p)) |> collect_list()
    let dripped = grids |> filter(g => g.pour()) |> count()

    write_line("{p:F1}    {cast double(dripped) / cast double(trials):F2}")

    if step == 5 then
        shown = grids |> find(g => g.drips() |> any(_ => true))
    fi
od

if let grid = shown then
    write_line()
    write_line("pictured: a grid with walls at p = 0.5 that drips")

    let cell = 30
    let image = IMAGE(width * cell + 20, height * cell + 40)

    image.view(
        -0.33D, cast double(height) + 0.33D,
        cast double(width) + 0.33D, -1.0D)

    image.clear(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)

    for row in 0..height do
        for column in 0..width do
            if grid.is_wet(column, row) then
                image.colour(120ub, 170ub, 235ub)

                let x = cast double(column)
                let y = cast double(row)

                image.fill_rectangle(x, y, x + 1.0D, y + 1.0D)
            fi
        od
    od

    image.colour(30ub, 30ub, 40ub)
    image.stroke(3.0D)

    for row in 0::height do
        for column in 0..width do
            if grid.floor(column, row) then
                let x = cast double(column)
                let y = cast double(row)

                image.line(x, y, x + 1.0D, y)
            fi
        od
    od

    for row in 0..height do
        for column in 0::width do
            if grid.side(column, row) then
                let x = cast double(column)
                let y = cast double(row)

                image.line(x, y, x, y + 1.0D)
            fi
        od
    od

    image.colour(40ub, 100ub, 210ub)

    for column in grid.drips() do
        image.dot(
            cast double(column) + 0.5D, cast double(height) + 0.2D, 5.0D)
    od

    image.write("bonds.png")
    image.show("bonds.png")
fi
